# Kitchen tests that fail under headless labwc (native Wayland, no X11
# display) and pass under Xvfb. wayland-tests.yml fails a PR only on a failure
# that is not listed here, and asks for a line to be removed once its test
# passes. One test name per line, exactly as defineTest names it.
#
# On a real desktop, the compositor's config can add failures: Omarchy's
# Hyprland sets suppress_event = maximize on every window, so "Window
# maximize/unmaximize" and "Window resize event" (which maximizes) fail there
# (T1032).

# Wayland clients can't place themselves or read their position (x/y stay 0),
# so position checks fail; sizes, maximize and state restore pass on labwc.
Window setPosition
Window recreated from getFrame keeps its place and size
Window setFrame

# Focus/blur follow the compositor's activated state (T964), but a headless
# compositor has no input device, so there's no activation serial and
# window.focus() can't move focus between windows.
Window focus and blur events (titleBarStyle: default)
Window focus and blur events (titleBarStyle: hiddenInset)
Window focus and blur events (titleBarStyle: hidden)

# WGPU surfaces are X11 child windows; there is no Wayland surface yet.
UIWindow mounts, lays out, and disposes
Reactive props update the mounted tree
Hit testing resolves the innermost hittable node
wgpuSurface creates a native Dawn view positioned by layout
webview element creates and removes an OOPIF webview
WGPU FFI smoke test
WebGPU adapter: writeTexture + render pass
WebGPU adapter: canvas resize reconfigures surface
WebGPU adapter: texture view variants
WebGPU adapter: depth attachment render pass
WebGPU adapter: bind group layout
WebGPU adapter: sampler descriptor
WebGPU adapter: copyBufferToTexture
Babylon adapter: textured quad
